body:
before dawn: the crop trial crew brought rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I washed everything twice before the county van arrived.

I meant to ask about it in the morning. By then the person who could answer had gone with the last vehicle, and this was all that remained.

I thought someone would ask for this at the gate. They asked instead how many were in the car, and let the paper stay in my hand.
title: Before dawn: rinsed gloves
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
